title: Q3
description:
“Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You have prepared for Me.”
Read: Psa 40:6–8
a) The Hebrew of Psa 40:6 reads “My ears You have opened.” Hebrews follows the Greek Old Testament, “a body You have prepared for Me.” What does each wording bring forward about willing obedience, and how does Hebrews use “body” (10:10)?
